name: Sunset Lamp — Tall Stand with Remote
description: A USB-powered sunset lamp on a slim stand, 24 cm tall. The round head tilts and rotates to aim the light, and a remote control changes the colour. Available in black and orange.
notes: Listing is a 10-style range, ¥3.3 to ¥15.5 (₦736 to ₦3,459 on the page); per-style price not shown, so unit_cost is blank. USB powered, no battery, ships by air. Return rate cut off in screenshot. Seller text claims remote switches 16 colours: not repeated. Supplier banner with certification claims cropped out and not repeated. 24 cm height taken from the dimension text on the supplier image. Two remote shapes (round and 24-key) appear in photos; which one ships is unconfirmed. Photos are cut-outs from an 800 px original; black one has slightly rough edges at the base.
